_comment: B-tier shared case table for EVERY hub-port reader (owner ruling 2026-09-24; value rule R7b F9). A valid value — the VCT_HUB_PORT env and the WHOLE content of <state dir>/hub.port alike — is, after trimming leading/trailing whitespace, ASCII [0-9]{1,5} in 1..65535: no sign, no `_`, no non-ASCII numerals, no internal whitespace (which includes a second line). Anything else is invalid and falls through to the next source. `expect` is the CLIENT ladder (env pin → file → 7700): vco_lib.hub_ensure.resolve_hub_port, the sh/ps1 clients (tests/test_v0297_hub_port_clients.py) and launcher/tools/vct-cli/src/main.rs's table-loaded test (include_str!). `expect_running` is the DESCRIBE-the-running-hub ladder (file → env → 7700): vco_lib.hub_ensure.running_hub_port and vct_launcher_core::services::hub_port::resolve_hub_port. `expect_file` is the STRICT file-only read (null = no port): vco_lib.hub_ensure.read_hub_port_file and hub_port::read_hub_port_file_in. The env rows also drive the hub's own bind port (vct-hub server.rs resolve_bind_port: a valid env pin is bound, an invalid one falls through to the hub's setting, else 7700). MUST stay in lockstep with every consumer named here.
